general_information.name: OH—MY NAME? I MEAN, THE DOCUMENTS… YOU WANT THE FULL THING, RIGHT? I’M ROBERT, ROBERT ANSELL. THAT’S THE NAME I GO BY.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been mostly since the cancer diagnosis four months ago… I’ve been low, not eating much, and sort of pulling away from everyone. I’m between chemo cycles now, and I keep thinking I’d rather it just took me quickly, though I don’t have a plan or anything like that.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to get through the treatment, really… and maybe be some use to my wife again.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yeah… I had oncology counselling. It was at the cancer centre, back in 2026, maybe about three sessions—something like that.; It was in 2026, at the cancer centre.; About three sessions, I think.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Ondansetron.; Dose: Eight milligrams twice a day as needed, I think—8 mg twice daily PRN, if that’s how you write it.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2026.; Side Effects: Constipation, from that one.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yeah, there is another one… Ramipril.; Dose: 10 mg each morning.; Start Or Duration: Started back in 2014.; Side Effects: None that I know of. No known side effects, really.

medical_history.medical_conditions: And hypertension — that was diagnosed in 2014.
medical_history.surgical_history: Surgery: Hemicolectomy.; Date: In 2026.; Details: No, nothing else to add.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Previous; Substance or product: Beer.; Quantity or frequency: Two or three at weekends.; Duration: Unknown
substance_use.nonmedical_nicotine_use: Status: Previous; Substance or product: Cigarettes.; Quantity or frequency: About 20 per day.; Duration: About 30 years, and I stopped in 2010.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Self-employed.; Job Title: Plumber.; Dates: 1985 to 2025.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born and raised in Toronto… from a practical, working family, that’s how I’d put it. I don’t know, I was just a kid, nothing unusual really.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I left school when I was 18 to start a plumbing apprenticeship. That’s… pretty much the main thing from then.
personal_history.significant_relationships: My marriage, really—that’s the big one. We’ve been together 36 years, and it’s current. We’re close. Also, we’ve got three adult children.
personal_history.future_goals: I’d like to see my treatment through and… get back to the workshop, if I can.
